evidence.note: Evidence presence is not localization correctness. Zero counts may legitimately have no object boxes. Human review or annotated boxes are required to score evidence accuracy.

unique_facts.note: Canonical count intents are grouped by model, image content/path, requested page, category and configuration. This includes bilingual pairs; agreement is not correctness and may result from shared cached extraction.

metric_notes: Abstentions, errors and unsupported cases remain in the all-labeled accuracy denominator.
No semantic judge is used: text answers match after trimming outer whitespace; numeric values match exactly; booleans remain distinct from numbers.
MAE covers only answered numeric targets and must be interpreted with coverage.
Model-proposed answers for needs_review are not scored as final answers; proposal_diagnostics separately measures proposed values and excludes errors/unsupported cases.
Missing pricing or unreported usage is unknown, not free. Provider retries can add unreported charges.
